Hello [user_name], the official language on this forum is English. Please submit your posts in English. The [product_name] from the [article_no] series with order numbers [article_no] do not feature the firmware necessary for using the [product_name] web editor, and firmware updates will not add this capability. Web pages created with the [product_name] Web Editor can only be displayed on the Web Server with the newer [product_name] 8.2, order number [article_no], which has been available since December 2017.

analysis.insight_summary: A user asked about compatibility between specific [product_name] 8 modules and the [product_name] Web Editor. The reply clarified that the modules discussed lack support for the web editor, and this cannot be resolved by firmware updates. Only newer [product_name] 8.2 modules provide this functionality. There is evident confusion about which modules support the web editor and if updates can resolve compatibility, showing a gap in documentation or communication of these details.
